summary.intent: Close four named test-coverage gaps (npm::round_trip, parse_publish_target/release_trigger, probe_git, pre_cursor) via strict TDD with independent read-only review per fix, then recommend how to handle 41 unverified audit findings. The session then expanded to CI/lint fixes, rebasing PR #11, and drafting a handoff prompt for Track 7.
summary.outcome: Confirmed just ci green, closed gaps 1-3 with commits (5774039, 345021a, 308fbf3), and fixed a real npm prerelease-truncation bug. Gap 4 (pre_cursor deletion) was rejected by the reviewer because the spec documents the feature; its resolution is not visible in the transcript. Also diagnosed the stale-wasm test failure, committed the lint fix (4a26f23), rebased and merged PR #11, and produced a Track 7 prompt for a fresh session. The 41-finding recommendation was not delivered.

repo: just ci has 7 phases (fmt-check, lint, test, audit, doc-check, wasm-check, coverage); piping it through tail without pipefail gives tail's exit code, so capture output to a file and check the real exit code.
Pre-commit and pre-push hooks run fmt-check with a 120-width rustfmt config; manual conflict resolutions need cargo fmt before committing or pushing.
moon run :lint fanned out one cargo clippy -p per crate sharing one target/ dir, so Cargo's build lock serialized them (~63 min). A single cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets takes ~5m13s.
pre-push uses a lint-affected recipe that queries moon's project graph for crates affected since the base branch, then lints them in one cargo invocation.

crates/callisto-moon/tests/moon_wasm_sandbox.rs resolve_wasm_file() only checks that the wasm artifact exists and is >100 bytes, so a stale target/wasm32-wasip1 artifact survives version bumps and breaks register_extension_matches_moon_wire_protocol.

GitAccess::discover is documented 'Never fails', returns Self, and has about 10 independent call sites, so there is no funnel for wiring a git-version probe. Workspace::load is deliberately lazy about git, enforced by the test workspace_load_does_not_build_tag_index_until_tags_is_called.
check_moon_version and check_git_version are deliberately unwired version-check primitives; each has its own test and no production callers.

The pre-cursor design (refs/callisto/pre-cursor/<PackageId>) is specified in docs/00-design.md §8 and docs/01-spec.md §C.6, §G.9.2 and §G.10.1. PreState.initial_versions solves a different problem (version sequencing, not commit-range idempotency).
Commit-inference pathspecs in aggregate.rs:177 are built from manifest file paths rather than package directories, so inference only fires on manifest changes.
Moon projects inherit global tasks; a pseudo-project at the repo root needs workspace: {inheritedTasks: {include: []}} to avoid inheriting test/lint tasks.

code.finding: npm round_trip/render_at_precision silently truncated prerelease targets to major.minor.patch. Fixed with a target.is_prerelease() guard that mirrors cargo.rs. The original_clause.contains('-') half of cargo's guard is unnecessary because round_trip already declines hyphenated clauses.
The render_at_precision is_prerelease branch has no dedicated unit test (sibling gap flagged by reviewer, out of scope).
parse_publish_target and parse_release_trigger were already correct but only partly tested; 7 new tests added with no production change.
since is computed unconditionally from last_tag, with no pre-mode branch, although docs/01-spec.md:6531 specifies pre-mode ? tags.pre_cursor(P) : last-tag.

commits_since_with_pathspec still does two unbounded rev_walk(...).all() calls (HEAD and since) and set-differences them. A bounded-walk rewrite must preserve the earlier branchy-history break-vs-continue fix (commit 7e3391bc).

workflow: Independent read-only reviewers, especially adversarial ones for deletion decisions, caught a factually wrong justification (pre_cursor 'not specified anywhere') that mechanical build/test/clippy checks could not.
Grep the spec and docs for a feature before declaring code dead or abandoned.
A hung-looking build can come from corrupted incremental cache after repeated kill -9; clearing target/debug/incremental/*<target>* let the compile finish.
Use git push --force-with-lease after a rebase, and verify the PR's headRefOid matches local HEAD.
Re-verify audit findings against current code before writing handoff prompts, since line numbers and status drift.

friction: The first just ci run was piped through tail, giving a misleading exit code and requiring a full rerun.
The pre-commit hook rejected gap 2's commit for formatting, so the commit had to be redone after cargo fmt.
The moon_wasm_sandbox compile appeared hung for 17+ minutes, and background cargo processes contended for the target/ lock, wasting a lot of session time.
The Option B moon-cache prototype added a root project that inherited moon's test task and broke just ci; it was ultimately reverted.
Several background task wakeups were stale or duplicated, and one test task was killed with no output.
Foreground command timeouts (2 min) cut off cargo test runs and forced reruns in the background.
open_items: The pre_cursor removal was rejected by the reviewer (spec documents the feature) and its final resolution is not shown. Either wire it per spec (aggregate.rs since branch, apply_version_plan step 8) or remove it with matching spec/design edits.
The 41 unverified medium/low audit findings still need a recommendation and the user's scope decision.
Make resolve_wasm_file() in moon_wasm_sandbox.rs check artifact version/freshness; the user chose to keep only the immediate fix.
Add a unit test for the cargo.rs render_at_precision target.is_prerelease() branch.
Track 7: bounded revwalk in commits_since_with_pathspec, per-package glob-matcher recompile in tags.rs matching_tags, and the aggregate.rs:177 inference pathspec bug.
Redundant manifest re-reads (workspace-root Cargo.toml read up to 3x per command) are unverified and potentially stale.
Phase 4 parallel items (Track 8-mechanical, Track 11/12) and deferred Phase 5 (moon.yml extensions.callisto, test/fixture infrastructure).
Option B moon-level lint caching was dropped without ever verifying a (cached, ...) hit.
The handoff doc and ACTIVE.md updates needed to reflect Track 7 and the gap-closure outcomes.
